pass_a_gloss: All things written about God, even if they appear from Himself, must be regarded as worthy of thought as belonging to a good God. For who would not say that the things brought back to God—having Him as wrath, using Him in anger, repenting Him, even causing Him to sleep—are to be considered worthy of God? But each of these will be found worthy of God by the one who knows how to hear obscure words.
